properties.label: Microsoft Graph Configuration
properties.description:
Configure Microsoft Graph application credentials used to access tenant-wide Outlook calendar data.

Purpose:
• Used to authenticate Microsoft Graph using application permissions.
• Allows the system to read calendar events for all users in the tenant.
• Required for background execution and scheduled sync jobs.

Configuration Guidelines:
• Tenant ID – Azure AD tenant identifier (Directory ID).
• Client ID – Application (App Registration) ID from Azure Portal.
• Client Secret – Secret generated under App Registration.

Important Notes:
• App must have Microsoft Graph Calendar.Read or Calendars.Read permissions.
• Permissions must be granted as Application permissions (not delegated).
• Admin consent is required.
• Credentials are used only on server-side execution.

properties.label: Target Form Configuration
properties.description:
Select the Joget form where synced calendar data will be stored.

Behavior:
• Each Microsoft calendar event is converted into a new form record.
• The form acts as a data store for time or activity entries.
• Records are created or updated automatically by the system.

Technical Notes:
• The selected form must already exist.
• Form table name is resolved automatically at runtime.
• This tool does not require user interaction with the form.

properties.label: Extended Property Mapping
properties.description:
Configure Microsoft Graph singleValueExtendedProperty used to associate calendar events with business data.

Purpose:
• Used to read a custom identifier stored on Microsoft calendar events.
• Common examples include Matter ID, Case ID, or Reference ID.
• Enables linking tenant-wide calendar events to internal Joget records.

GUID & Name Guidelines:
• GUID must be a valid UUID in the format:
  xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
• Name must exactly match the property name used during event creation.
• GUID and Name together define one single extended property.

Rules:
• Only one value is supported per event.
• Do NOT use separators such as ;, ,, or multiple values.
• Value is stored as plain text in the mapped form field.

Important Notes:
• If GUID or Name is incorrect, events will still sync but extended value will be empty.
• This property is optional but recommended for business correlation.

properties.name: extendedPropField
properties.label: Target Form Field for Extended Property
Field Mapping
properties.description:
Map Microsoft calendar event data to Joget form fields.

Field Usage:
• Event ID Field – Stores the unique Microsoft event ID.
• Event Subject Field – Stores the calendar event subject/title.
• User Field – Stores the event owner’s email address.
• Duration Field – Stores calculated event duration in HH:mm:ss format.

Technical Behavior:
• Only completed events are processed.
• All-day and cancelled events are skipped automatically.
• Duration is calculated using event start and end time (UTC).
• Each sync creates new records with system-generated row IDs.

properties.label: Technical Configuration Notes
properties.description:
This plugin is designed to run as a Process Tool or Scheduler Plugin.

Execution Behavior:
• Runs without user interaction.
• Fetches events for all tenant users using Microsoft Graph.
• Sync window is determined using a system environment variable.
• Last successful sync time is stored automatically.

Scheduling Recommendations:
• Can be scheduled hourly, daily, or as required.
• First run uses a fallback window of the last 24 hours.
• Subsequent runs sync only newly completed events.

Reliability:
• Duplicate processing is avoided using sync timestamps.
• Safe to run repeatedly.
• Designed for long-running background execution.
